newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close higher on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close higher on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Sunday on bullish sentiment in selected blue chips, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 14.54 points, or 1.07 percent, higher at 1,371.17 amid 109 gainers and 85 losers. One dealer said the index could rise further on Monday.

PSO jumped 5.50 rupees to 272.50, PTCL 0.40 rupee to 24.50, HUBCO 0.60 to 33.75, Dewan Salman 0.30 to 32.65, Adamjee Insurance 4.25 to 89 and Fauji Fertilizer 3.00 to 69. Parke Davis fell 5.00 to 485.
